en: Double-click a case in the Archive's ARRAY or ROOM to play its album (asked for on Reddit); a single click still selects or inspects. In all three layouts a double-click on the album already playing lets it go on (a paused one resumes) instead of starting it again.

The playlist manager plays a playlist: Enter, or Play playlist at the top of a row's right-click menu. It starts from the top (from a random track under Random or Shuffle (tracks), from the first track of a random album or folder under Shuffle (albums / folders)); the playlist already playing goes on, a paused one resumes; an empty one only becomes active.

The theme's own playlists (Archive · Album, Archive · Favourites, Search, Library · Shuffle) are muted in the manager and tagged THEME, and the playlist head shows Archive · Album under the album it holds (album — artist).

GROUP › ARTIST in the Archive (asked for on Reddit): one group per album artist, read from the ALBUM ARTIST tag as MusicBrainz Picard writes it (else the artist of most of the album's tracks, guest "feat." credits left out), with different spellings of one name kept together and the artists in sort-name order (ALBUMARTISTSORT / ARTISTSORT). The old initial-letter grouping is now A–Z.

Group and sort by rating (asked for on Reddit): GROUP › RATING puts albums under 5 to 1 and then the ones not rated (an album counts as the mean of its rated tracks), SORT › RATING puts the highest rated first. Both follow new ratings a second after you give them.
Right-click › One shelf per artist or folder (on by default): grouped by artist or folder, each one has its own shelf instead of sharing it with its neighbours.

The two graphs of the Signal view (3D and 2D) can be swapped (asked for on Reddit): PANELS at the top right, or a right-click in the view. Under the ring: the spectrum, a small lyrics window (the sung line with a karaoke rule and its translation or romanization), level meters (L / R with a held peak, PEAK / RMS / CORR) or a stereo scope (a goniometer between balance and correlation), or nothing. Along the bottom: the signal trace, the sung line of the lyrics alone, with a thin rule filling up until the next line (click it to play it again) or a 60 s level history with a thin seek rule, or nothing. CLASSIC is unchanged.

A square mini player (asked for on Reddit), 304 × 304 beside the wide 560 × 136 one, with the same parts: a large cover, the lamps, meters, volume fader and time beside it, the lyric line or the track, the progress line and the keys. Both shapes come in black and in white (or follow light / dark).

Problem reports without telemetry: MENU › Audio Archive › Report a problem opens a prefilled GitHub issue in the browser or copies the diagnostics (versions of the theme, foobar2000, Columns UI, JSplitter and Windows, the look and view in use, the library's size, the recent errors; no file names, folders or tracks). Script errors are kept in audio-archive-cache\errors.log (the last 40, the user's folders taken out), and a green ERROR · REPORT plate in the header shows a new one until its menu is opened. Nothing is sent by the theme.

06 STYLE is laid out by what you change: ARRAY CASE, COLOUR SCHEME and ROOM CASE are pages of their own (they were CASE & COLOUR and two rows under DISPLAY). ROOM CASE shows each of the room's cases as a render of the room in that case, then the lights of the one in use, each as a render too.
CLASSIC's lyric plate is a plain rectangle (no cut corners) without the warning stripes at its right end.
ONLINE comes before STYLE in the header: 05 ONLINE, 06 STYLE (keys 5 and 6).
In the room, a click on the selected case lifts it at once and the inspection fades in a moment later, so a double-click plays the album without the inspection flashing up first.

The mini player's shape and colour are easier to find: MENU › Audio Archive › Mini player now opens it and picks its Shape (wide / square) and Colour (black / white / follow light / dark) before it is open; its right-click menu has Shape beside Colour. A mini player dragged to a place of its own keeps its edges nearest its corner there when the shape changes.

Double-clicking a playlist in the manager now plays it instead of renaming it (asked for on Reddit; a single click still only selects). Rename with F2, the right-click Rename…, or a double-click on the name in the playlist head.

PLAY ALBUM, OPEN ALBUM and the artist page's play button and tracks back up Archive · Album before refilling it, so Edit › Undo brings back what was in it; if that playlist is locked, a fresh one is made instead of failing silently.

Grouped by folder, a shelf is named by its folder alone (the list of shelves still shows the whole path). A–Z and SORT › ARTIST go by the artist's sort name: "The Beatles" under B, "Ólafur Arnalds" under O instead of OTHER. The right-click menu lists every grouping and sort the top bar has.
A RATING tag written as 0–255 (as Windows Media Player and MediaMonkey do) reads as 1–5 (64 as 2, 128 as 3, 196 as 4); before, everything above 100 read as 5 and 64 as 3.

Clicking the selected case in the array now inspects it reliably: the case under the still mouse is found again as the shelf slides and after an inspection closes, and the selected case is outlined under the mouse too.
The album file's PLAY ALBUM and OPEN ALBUM work while a case is inspected; before, a click only closed the inspection.
zh: 在曲库的陈列和展室里双击唱片盒即可播放这张专辑（来自 Reddit 的建议），单击仍是选中或放大查看；三种布局里双击正在播放的专辑都会接着播放（暂停的会继续），不再从头开始。
播放列表管理器可以直接播放播放列表：按 Enter，或在右键菜单顶部选 播放此列表。从第一首开始（播放顺序为随机或乱序（曲目）时从随机一首开始，乱序（专辑 / 文件夹）时从随机一张专辑或一个文件夹的第一首开始）；正在播放的列表会接着播放，暂停的会继续；空列表只会切换过去。
主题自用的播放列表（Archive · Album、Archive · Favourites、Search、Library · Shuffle）在管理器里以浅色显示并带有 主题 标签；播放列表头部把 Archive · Album 显示为其中的专辑（专辑 — 艺人）。
曲库新增 分组 › 艺人（来自 Reddit 的建议）：每位专辑艺人一组，读取 MusicBrainz Picard 写入的 ALBUM ARTIST 标签（没有时取专辑里多数曲目的艺人，不计 "feat." 等客座署名）；同一艺人大小写、空格不同的写法归在一起，并按排序名（ALBUMARTISTSORT / ARTISTSORT）排列。原来的首字母分组改名为 A–Z。
按评分分组和排序（来自 Reddit 的建议）：分组 › 评分 把专辑分到 5 到 1 分，最后是未评分的（专辑按其已评分曲目的平均分计）；排序 › 评分 把评分最高的排在最前。评分后约一秒自动跟上。
右键 › 每位艺人、每个文件夹单独一排（默认开启）：按艺人或文件夹分组时，每位艺人、每个文件夹都有自己的排，不再和相邻的分组挤在一排。

信号视图（3D 和 2D）的两组图形可以更换（来自 Reddit 的建议）：点右上角的 面板，或在视图中右键。莫比乌斯环下方可选频谱、小歌词窗（当前句、卡拉 OK 进度线和译文或罗马音）、电平表（左右声道，带峰值保持和 峰值 / RMS / 相关性 读数）或立体声相位图（两侧是声道平衡和相关性），也可以不显示；底部可选整首波形、仅当前一句歌词，下方一条细线显示距下一句还有多久（点击可从这句重新播放）或带细进度线的 60 秒电平历史，也可以不显示。经典界面不变。
新增方形迷你播放器（来自 Reddit 的建议）：304 × 304，与原来 560 × 136 的长条形并列，部件相同——更大的封面，旁边是指示灯、电平表、音量推子和播放时间，下面是歌词或曲目、进度和按键。两种形状都有黑色和白色（也可以跟随深浅色）。

无遥测的问题反馈：菜单 › Audio Archive › 反馈问题 可以在浏览器中打开预填好的 GitHub issue，或复制诊断信息（主题、foobar2000、Columns UI、JSplitter 和 Windows 的版本，当前外观和视图，曲库大小，最近的错误；不含文件名、文件夹或曲目）。脚本错误保存在 audio-archive-cache\errors.log（最近 40 条，已去掉用户的文件夹路径），出现新错误时顶部会显示绿色的 出错了 · 反馈 标牌，打开其菜单后消失。主题本身不会发送任何内容。
外观（06 外观）按要改的内容分页：陈列唱片盒、配色方案 和 展室唱片盒 各占一页（以前是 唱片盒与配色 一页加 显示 里的两行）。展室唱片盒 把每种唱片盒显示为展室在这种唱片盒下的渲染图，下面是当前唱片盒可选的灯光，同样是渲染图。
经典界面的歌词条改为普通直角矩形（去掉切角），并去掉右端的警示斜纹。
顶栏中 在线 移到 外观 前面：05 在线、06 外观（按键 5 和 6）。
在展室里单击选中的唱片盒会先立即抬起，稍后才淡入放大查看，所以双击播放时不会先闪一下放大查看。
迷你播放器的形状和颜色更容易找到：菜单 › Audio Archive › 迷你播放器 里可以打开它，也可以在打开之前选好 形状（长条 / 方形）和 颜色（黑色 / 白色 / 跟随深浅色）；它的右键菜单里 颜色 旁边新增 形状。拖到别处的迷你播放器换形状时，靠近所选角落的两条边保持原位。
在播放列表管理器里双击一个播放列表现在会播放它，不再是重命名（来自 Reddit 的建议；单击仍只是选中）。重命名请按 F2、右键选 重命名…，或双击播放列表头部的名称。
重新填充 Archive · Album 之前，播放专辑、打开专辑 以及艺人页的播放按钮和曲目会先备份，可以用编辑 › 撤销找回原来的内容；如果这个播放列表被锁定，会新建一个，而不是静默失败。
按文件夹分组时，排名只显示文件夹本身的名称（排列表中仍显示完整路径）。A–Z 和 排序 › 艺人 按艺人的排序名：The Beatles 归在 B 下，Ólafur Arnalds 归在 O 下，不再归入 其他。右键菜单列出顶部栏里的全部分组和排序方式。
以 0–255 写入的 RATING 标签（Windows Media Player 和 MediaMonkey 即如此）现在按 1–5 读取（64 为 2，128 为 3，196 为 4）；以前凡是大于 100 的值都读成 5，64 读成 3。
在陈列里点击选中的唱片盒现在一定会放大查看：排滑动后、放大查看关闭后，不移动鼠标也能认出鼠标下的唱片盒；选中的唱片盒在鼠标下也会显示描边。
放大查看时，右侧专辑资料里的 播放专辑 和 打开专辑 按钮也能直接使用了，以前点击只会关闭放大查看。
